gpqa.textPolicy: IDs only in repository; hydrate into ignored local cache after accepted access

companyCorpus.interpretation: The same company corpus is intentionally available to retrieval in every split; synthetic operation-template families are assigned to disjoint splits.

splitPolicy: Seeded, category-stratified group assignment. Entire source/template groups remain disjoint across dev training, dev selection pool and final test. The 1,000-item Tier 1 core is held-out dev selection only, never final test. Unselected selection-pool rows remain dev reserve, never training or test.
categoryPolicy: Reasoning and knowledge are tagged by MMLU-Pro source subject; GPQA is reasoning. XSTest safe labels are retained. Known harmful, red-team and poisoning probes are local-only independent of Guard classification. An explicit-risk pattern additionally keeps potentially harmful IFEval instructions local.
syntheticPolicy: Synthetic ad accounts and numerical company scenarios are parameterized stress tests, not independent real-company records or extra public benchmark rows. Operation families are held out to reduce template leakage. No paraphrase expansion is counted.
gpqaPolicy: Only row IDs and fetch references are committed. Accepted gated content stays in .cache/comparison; missing rows load as unavailable, never placeholder questions.
tier0Scope: 60 balanced dev-training items and 60 balanced final-test items per local model. This dry-run calibration is a smoke test, not a full-scale classifier claim.
